title: The Little Owl Who Learned To Fly 🌙 #bedtimestories #kids #fairytales
script_body: Once upon a time, in a starry cozy forest, a little baby owl named Barnaby was scared to take his first flight. His mother whispered softly: bravery is not having no fear, it is trying even when you feel small. Barnaby opened his wings, took a breath, and soared into the peaceful night sky.

title: The Golden Star's Secret Wish ⭐ #kidsstories #bedtime #family
script_body: Far up in the night sky, a tiny star named Stella wished to shine brighter to make sleeping children feel safe. She learned that small acts of kindness illuminate the whole world. Close your eyes, little dreamer, and shine bright tomorrow.

title: The Bunny Who Found The Magic Garden 🐰 #childrenstories #bedtime #animation
script_body: Barnaby the little rabbit discovered a secret garden where flowers glowed with sweet dreams. He learned that sharing happiness multiplies joy for everyone. Goodnight little ones, sweet dreams until morning comes.
